queries: WITH race_name_totals AS (SELECT r.name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) AS average_laps FROM results AS res JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = res.raceId GROUP BY r.name), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(total_points) AS average_total FROM race_name_totals) SELECT SUM(g.total_points) AS sum_total_points, AVG(g.average_laps) AS average_laps, AVG(g.total_points - b.average_total) AS average_excess_points FROM race_name_totals AS g CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE g.total_points > b.average_total;
